# Berrylink

> Berrylink is a K-Beauty brand production agency specialized in the CIS and Islamic markets. Like a top entertainment agency producing global pop stars, Berrylink exclusively manages and produces Korean beauty brands for their debut in the challenging CIS and Islamic markets — a launchpad for worldwide expansion.

- Company: Berrylink (베리링크)
- Service: exclusive brand production and management for K-Beauty (Korean cosmetics) brands entering CIS countries and Islamic markets
- Languages: English, Korean, Russian
- Contact: info@berrylink.io
- HQ: 510 5th F/L 23, Jungdongbuk-ro, Uichang-gu, Changwon-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, Republic of Korea
- Seoul Office: 210 2nd F/L 10, Nambusunhwan-ro 333-gil, Seocho-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea

- [Русский](https://berrylink.io/ru/): Продюсерское агентство K-Beauty брендов для стран СНГ и исламского мира
